title: A lo largo de: abarcar todo un periodo de tiempo

sections.content: A lo largo de (throughout, over the course of) spans an entire period of time, emphasizing that something happened continuously or repeatedly across it, not just once. It's followed by a time expression. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A lo largo de toda la década de 1980, el ingreso por habitante de América Latina prácticamente no creció.
items.english: Throughout the entire decade of the 1980s, Latin America's per capita income barely grew at all.

items.spanish: A lo largo de estos años, la deuda externa continuó creciendo en términos absolutos.
items.english: Throughout these years, external debt kept growing in absolute terms.

items.spanish: El Plan Brady marcó, a lo largo de los años noventa, el final formal de la crisis de la deuda.
items.english: The Brady Plan marked, over the course of the 1990s, the formal end of the debt crisis.

items.spanish: A lo largo de este periodo, millones de familias vieron caer de forma sostenida su nivel de vida.
items.english: Over the course of this period, millions of families saw their standard of living steadily decline.

sections.content: A lo largo de suits a process unfolding continuously across a stretch of time -- for a single point within a period, use durante instead, which is more neutral about continuity.
